decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - All waste, refuse, and recycling bins shall be stored inside the curtilage of the building and shall not be moved outside except to an awaiting vehicle after which they shall be immediately returned to inside the curtilage of the building.  No refuse or recyclable materials shall be stored outside the building's curtilage.
Condition : 7 - The extension herby permitted shall only be used for the storage of goods and servicing ancillary to the retail use of the premises known as 797 London Road, TW3 1RS.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to shop for storage use
